title: Implement elastic calendar geometry and exact navigation
verify: Lesson days occupy more weekly geometry than non-lesson days, weeks may vary independently, and date picker reaches the selected date.
Lesson state remains perceivable with a non-color cue.
evidence_required: FT-003-AC-001 RED: lesson/non-lesson geometry is equal, weeks are coupled, or date picker misses the selected date; GREEN: lesson days occupy more space independently per week and date picker reaches the exact selected date; artifact: .tasks/TASK-013-T2-FT-003-W7/ and .protocols/TASK-013-T2-FT-003-W7/verification.md.

FT-003-AC-002 RED: lesson state meaning disappears when color is removed; GREEN: geometry plus label/symbol/other cue preserves perceivability without color alone; artifact: .tasks/TASK-013-T2-FT-003-W7/ and .protocols/TASK-013-T2-FT-003-W7/verification.md.
purpose: Provide the calendar navigation surface that exposes the accepted learning rhythm.
success_outcome: Users can navigate exact dates through elastic weekly geometry, and lesson/non-lesson meaning is available without relying on color alone.
anti_goals: Do not make non-lesson days unreachable.
Do not put authorization or provider writes in the presentation component.
constraints: Use SSR-safe SvelteKit/Svelte 5 components and URL state only where navigation must survive reload.
Color is not the sole state signal.
invariants: Lesson days are visually more prominent than non-lesson days.
verification_targets: FT-003-AC-001: calendar UI smoke, exact date-picker navigation, independent-week geometry, and operator visual review against the accepted qualitative criterion.
FT-003-AC-002: color-independent accessibility review proving a non-color lesson-state cue.

stop_conditions: Stop if calendar geometry changes the accepted product target.
